# Phantom Blade Zero Wiki — Complete Weapons & Builds Guide

> Complete Phantom Blade Zero wiki: weapons database, top builds, boss guides, skill system breakdown, Sha-Chi combat mechanics, story and lore with all 8 endings. Free and regularly updated.

## Core Pages

- [PB Zero Wiki Home](https://pbzerowiki.com/): Entry point with all guides, weapons, and builds
- [Weapons Database](https://pbzerowiki.com/weapons.html): All 6 weapon types — stats, movesets, best picks
- [Weapon Tier List](https://pbzerowiki.com/weapon-tier-list.html): All weapons ranked S/A/B/C tier
- [Weapon Comparison Tool](https://pbzerowiki.com/weapon-compare.html): Side-by-side weapon stats
- [Best Builds](https://pbzerowiki.com/top-builds.html): Top 5 meta loadouts for 2026
- [All Bosses Guide](https://pbzerowiki.com/bosses.html): Every boss with mechanics and strategies
- [Combat System](https://pbzerowiki.com/combat-system.html): Sha-Chi mechanics, Ghoststep, parry timing
- [Beginner Guide](https://pbzerowiki.com/beginner-guide.html): Best starter weapons, early tips

## Key Guides
